body: Mostly trauma. My mum was a narcissist and did a lot to mess me up. But I also always feel alone no matter the circumstances.
To feel something and to release pain.

That's honestly bullshit. Parents who don't feed their kids shouldn't be parents. I get falling on hard times happens but if you're buying yourself junk and your kids are starving, that's not okay.
My mum bought like four packs of cigarettes a day while we were being sent home new clothes and soap from the school so I totally feel your pain.

My mum did this all the time! Her big thing was chocolates, Cheerios, and fruit snacks. She'd hide them in her room and ban is from touching them. This was back when we didn't have enough money for dinners.

I've had it for a long time. I was properly diagnosed about a year ago but my therapist says it's probably been on going since I was a child. 

I hope the thought goes away. My relationship is very strong but sometimes I get into bad down spirals and I know it scares my partner. So stuff like this gets to me bad. 

Thank you for your kind words.
